title.narrative: Écoles et hôpitaux américains à l'étranger (ASHA)
Écoles et hôpitaux américains à l'étranger (ASHA)
Escuelas y hospitales estadounidenses en el extranjero (ASHA)

description.narrative: ASHA Initiative provides assistance to schools, libraries, and medical centers outside the United States that serve as study and demonstration centers for American ideas and practices. ASHA awards help cultivate positive relationships between citizens of the United States and other nations
Projet USAID/OTI au Cameroun

L'Initiative ASHA fournit une assistance aux écoles, bibliothèques et centres médicaux en dehors des États-Unis qui servent de centres d'étude et de démonstration des idées et pratiques américaines. Les prix ASHA aident à cultiver des relations positives entre les citoyens des États-Unis et d’autres pays.

La Iniciativa ASHA brinda asistencia a escuelas, bibliotecas y centros médicos fuera de los Estados Unidos que sirven como centros de estudio y demostración de ideas y prácticas estadounidenses. Los premios ASHA ayudan a cultivar relaciones positivas entre ciudadanos de los Estados Unidos y otras naciones.

description.narrative: Global Health Supply Chain-Technical Assistance IDIQ, Francophone Task Order (USAID GHSC-TA, Francophone TO) project. The GHSC-TA Francophone TO will provide technical assistance for strengthening regional, national and sub-national health supply systems in the DRC, Senegal, Benin, and Haiti and will support the USAID/West Africa (USAID/WA) Regional Mission in Accra, Ghana, and will collaborate with other United States Government agencies, country governments, and non-governmental organizations to improve the long-term availability of health commodities. Additionally, the task order will develop a plan to improve preparedness to provide commodities needed to manage disease outbreaks with pandemic potential in select GHSA countries.

L'Initiative ASHA fournit une assistance aux écoles, bibliothèques et centres médicaux en dehors des États-Unis qui servent de centres d'étude et de démonstration des idées et pratiques américaines. Les prix ASHA aident à cultiver des relations positives entre les citoyens des États-Unis et d’autres pays.

Chaîne d’approvisionnement mondiale en santé – Assistance technique IDIQ, projet Francophone Task Order (USAID GHSC-TA, TO francophone). Le TO francophone GHSC-TA fournira une assistance technique pour le renforcement des systèmes d'approvisionnement en santé régionaux, nationaux et sous-nationaux en RDC, au Sénégal, au Bénin et en Haïti et soutiendra la mission régionale de l'USAID/Afrique de l'Ouest (USAID/WA) à Accra, au Ghana, et collaborera avec d'autres agences gouvernementales des États-Unis, les gouvernements des pays et les organisations non gouvernementales pour améliorer la disponibilité à long terme des produits de santé. En outre, l'ordre de travail élaborera un plan visant à améliorer la préparation afin de fournir les produits nécessaires à la gestion des épidémies à potentiel pandémique dans certains pays de la GHSA.

description.narrative: Develop and conduct needs assessments, baseline studies, targeted evaluations, special studies or other information-gathering efforts specifically for the design, monitoring and evaluation of USG-funded programs. This sub-element may also include developing and disseminating best practices and lessons learned, testing demonstration and/or pilot models, or the preparation of strategic plans and other short-term programming tasks. Note: All such activities that are carried out by partners as an integral part of their monitoring and evaluation efforts for programs funded under other sub-elements should be included within those sub-elements.

Chaîne d’approvisionnement mondiale en santé – Assistance technique IDIQ, projet Francophone Task Order (USAID GHSC-TA, TO francophone). Le TO francophone GHSC-TA fournira une assistance technique pour le renforcement des systèmes d'approvisionnement en santé régionaux, nationaux et sous-nationaux en RDC, au Sénégal, au Bénin et en Haïti et soutiendra la mission régionale de l'USAID/Afrique de l'Ouest (USAID/WA) à Accra, au Ghana, et collaborera avec d'autres agences gouvernementales des États-Unis, les gouvernements des pays et les organisations non gouvernementales pour améliorer la disponibilité à long terme des produits de santé. En outre, l'ordre de travail élaborera un plan visant à améliorer la préparation afin de fournir les produits nécessaires à la gestion des épidémies à potentiel pandémique dans certains pays de la GHSA.

Développer et mener des évaluations des besoins, des études de base, des évaluations ciblées, des études spéciales ou d'autres efforts de collecte d'informations spécifiquement pour la conception, le suivi et l'évaluation des programmes financés par le gouvernement américain. Ce sous-élément peut également inclure l’élaboration et la diffusion des meilleures pratiques et des enseignements tirés, le test de modèles de démonstration et/ou pilotes, ou la préparation de plans stratégiques et d’autres tâches de programmation à court terme. Remarque : Toutes les activités menées par les partenaires dans le cadre de leurs efforts de suivi et d'évaluation des programmes financés au titre d'autres sous-éléments doivent être incluses dans ces sous-éléments.

description.narrative: Support That Augments Rapid Transition (START) Indefinite Quantity Contract (IQC)

Développer et mener des évaluations des besoins, des études de base, des évaluations ciblées, des études spéciales ou d'autres efforts de collecte d'informations spécifiquement pour la conception, le suivi et l'évaluation des programmes financés par le gouvernement américain. Ce sous-élément peut également inclure l’élaboration et la diffusion des meilleures pratiques et des enseignements tirés, le test de modèles de démonstration et/ou pilotes, ou la préparation de plans stratégiques et d’autres tâches de programmation à court terme. Remarque : Toutes les activités menées par les partenaires dans le cadre de leurs efforts de suivi et d'évaluation des programmes financés au titre d'autres sous-éléments doivent être incluses dans ces sous-éléments.

description.narrative: Banyan Global is implementing the Gender Integration Technical Assistance (GITA) task order under the Advancing the Agenda of Gender Equality (ADVANTAGE) indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity (IDIQ) contract. GITA provides on-demand, rapid response short-term technical assistance (STTA) to the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) Missions and Bureaus across sectors. Banyan Global applies its expertise in gender research and practice to the process of designing, implementing, monitoring and evaluating USAID strategies, projects, and activities to reduce the gender and economic empowerment gaps that impede development outcomes.

Banyan Global está implementando la orden de trabajo de Asistencia Técnica para la Integración de Género (GITA) en virtud del contrato de entrega indefinida/cantidad indefinida (IDIQ) para Avanzar en la Agenda de Igualdad de Género (ADVANTAGE). GITA proporciona asistencia técnica a corto plazo (STTA) de respuesta rápida y bajo demanda a las misiones y oficinas de la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional (USAID) en todos los sectores. Banyan Global aplica su experiencia en investigación y práctica de género al proceso de diseño, implementación, seguimiento y evaluación de estrategias, proyectos y actividades de USAID para reducir las brechas de género y empoderamiento económico que impiden los resultados de desarrollo.

description.narrative: The purpose of this task order is to support PMI, as well as USAID Missions, Country Offices, and Bureaus with malaria programs, in planning and implementing IRS programs and other proven, life-saving malaria vector control interventions with the overall goal of reducing the burden of malaria in Africa. This task order will enhance USAID's ability to implement IRS and integrated malaria vector control programs on the ground through cost-effective commodities procurement and logistics systems, and access to technical expertise in countries affected by malaria.
Ordre de tâche au Tchad dans le cadre de SWIFT IV IQC

Le but de cette commande de tâches est de soutenir PMI, ainsi que les missions, bureaux de pays et bureaux de l'USAID dotés de programmes de lutte contre le paludisme, dans la planification et la mise en œuvre de programmes IRS et d'autres interventions éprouvées et salvatrices de lutte contre les vecteurs du paludisme dans le but global de réduire le fardeau du paludisme en Afrique. Cette commande de tâches améliorera la capacité de l'USAID à mettre en œuvre des programmes IRS et de lutte intégrée contre les vecteurs du paludisme sur le terrain grâce à des systèmes d'approvisionnement et de logistique de produits rentables et à l'accès à l'expertise technique dans les pays touchés par le paludisme.

O objectivo desta ordem de tarefa é apoiar a PMI, bem como as missões, escritórios nacionais e gabinetes da USAID com programas de malária, no planeamento e implementação de programas de IRS e outras intervenções comprovadas de controlo de vectores de malária que salvam vidas, com o objectivo geral de reduzir o fardo da malária em África. Esta tarefa aumentará a capacidade da USAID de implementar o IRS e programas integrados de controlo dos vectores da malária no terreno através de sistemas de aquisição e logística de produtos com boa relação custo-eficácia e acesso a conhecimentos técnicos em países afectados pela malária.

description.narrative: Improve the ability of the USG, host countries and other partners to prepare for and mitigate the effects of disasters, including both natural disasters and complex emergencies, taking into account the differences in men and womens freedom of movement and access to information. Activities under this component include any efforts to enhance the capacities of the USG (in Washington and in the field), humanitarian assistance providers, national host-country authorities, and local communities to engage in disaster reduction and response activities. Activities consist of standardized and coordinated assessments, monitoring, information sharing, data and situational analysis, joint planning; enhancement of coping mechanisms, including the capacity to address adaptation to constantly changing situations on the ground including climate variability and climate change.

description.narrative: Improve the ability of the USG, host countries and other partners to prepare for and mitigate the effects of disasters, including both natural disasters and complex emergencies, taking into account the differences in men and womens freedom of movement and access to information. Activities under this component include any efforts to enhance the capacities of the USG (in Washington and in the field), humanitarian assistance providers, national host-country authorities, and local communities to engage in disaster reduction and response activities. Activities consist of standardized and coordinated assessments, monitoring, information sharing, data and situational analysis, joint planning; enhancement of coping mechanisms, including the capacity to address adaptation to constantly changing situations on the ground including climate variability and climate change.

description.narrative: Improve the ability of the USG, host countries and other partners to prepare for and mitigate the effects of disasters, including both natural disasters and complex emergencies, taking into account the differences in men and womens freedom of movement and access to information. Activities under this component include any efforts to enhance the capacities of the USG (in Washington and in the field), humanitarian assistance providers, national host-country authorities, and local communities to engage in disaster reduction and response activities. Activities consist of standardized and coordinated assessments, monitoring, information sharing, data and situational analysis, joint planning; enhancement of coping mechanisms, including the capacity to address adaptation to constantly changing situations on the ground including climate variability and climate change.

sector.narrative: Relief co-ordination; protection and support services

description.narrative: Improve the ability of the USG, host countries and other partners to prepare for and mitigate the effects of disasters, including both natural disasters and complex emergencies, taking into account the differences in men and womens freedom of movement and access to information. Activities under this component include any efforts to enhance the capacities of the USG (in Washington and in the field), humanitarian assistance providers, national host-country authorities, and local communities to engage in disaster reduction and response activities. Activities consist of standardized and coordinated assessments, monitoring, information sharing, data and situational analysis, joint planning; enhancement of coping mechanisms, including the capacity to address adaptation to constantly changing situations on the ground including climate variability and climate change.

Fournir des biens, du personnel, des services et une assistance pour répondre aux besoins humains fondamentaux afin de favoriser la transition après les secours selon les principes d'universalité, d'impartialité et de dignité humaine. Programs are designed to incorporate and support mechanisms that advance conflict mediation, resolution and negotiation of disputes in the context of these processes.

title.narrative: NGO Legal Enabling Environment Program (LEEP II)

description.narrative: (Europe and Eurasia Regional): The NGO Legal Enabling Environment Program seeks to create legal and regulatory frameworks to protect and promote the legal environment for civil society. Specific activities include short-term, technical assistance, fellowships, and the production and dissemination of NGO legal research educational materials. The scope also includes issues related to NGO access to financing, freedom of expression, online freedoms and access to information. Focus countries are selected on an annual basis. In FY2017, Azerbaijan, Kosovo, Ukraine and Moldova received support. .An enabling legislative and regulatory framework is essential to promote the development and sustainability of the civic sector. As many countries in E&E are seeking to crack down on the sector via restrictive and cumbersome legislation, this activity is becoming even more important, as it allows for timely and well researched analysis and supports in country advocacy initiatives.

description.narrative: The Textbooks and Learning Materials Program (TLMP), a component of the Africa Education Initiative was launched in 2002 to work with African governments and Ministries of Education to create substantial solution to the many pressing educational challenges in six sub-Saharan countries, including lack of adequate educational materials and insufficient training for teachers. Since the launch of the program in 2002, TLMP has provided over 5 Million workbooks, teachers guides, related resources and teaching materials within 14 districts in Ghana for use in Kindergarten to Primary 3 classrooms.

description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

Apoia os seguintes custos ilustrativos financiados pelo programa: salários dos EUA, FSN e TCN e outros funcionários, como PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs que trabalham para o governo dos EUA, gerenciando, administrando e apoiando programas e seus benefícios financiados pelo programa, como habitação, viagens, transporte, subsídios de educação, etc.; contratantes institucionais que fornecem esse pessoal, aluguel, serviços de TI, a parcela de serviços públicos financiada pelo programa, custos de treinamento de pessoal e o custo de desenvolvimento e administração de programas de treinamento, equipamentos e suprimentos, ICASS, combustível e manutenção de veículos, contratos de manutenção, serviços de zeladoria, desenvolvimento e manutenção de páginas da unidade operacional na web, divulgação, como publicações e o custo de sua preparação (incluindo custos de pessoal), e assistência técnica para garantir a conformidade do USG com os regulamentos.

description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

Apoia os seguintes custos ilustrativos financiados pelo programa: salários dos EUA, FSN e TCN e outros funcionários, como PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs que trabalham para o governo dos EUA, gerenciando, administrando e apoiando programas e seus benefícios financiados pelo programa, como habitação, viagens, transporte, subsídios de educação, etc.; contratantes institucionais que fornecem esse pessoal, aluguel, serviços de TI, a parcela de serviços públicos financiada pelo programa, custos de treinamento de pessoal e o custo de desenvolvimento e administração de programas de treinamento, equipamentos e suprimentos, ICASS, combustível e manutenção de veículos, contratos de manutenção, serviços de zeladoria, desenvolvimento e manutenção de páginas da unidade operacional na web, divulgação, como publicações e o custo de sua preparação (incluindo custos de pessoal), e assistência técnica para garantir a conformidade do USG com os regulamentos.

Objectives for India: The USAID Emerging Pandemic Threats PREDICT program aims to strengthen global capacity for detection and discovery of zoonotic viruses with pandemic potential. PREDICT uses a One Health approach to conduct targeted surveillance in key wildlife and livestock species, as well as people who have contact with these animals. In collaboration with GHSA and state and national partners, including reference laboratories, PREDICT works to characterize the diversity of unknown viruses in nature and enhance India’s ability to detect and respond to new and emerging viral zoonoses.

title.narrative: Pandemic Influenza and Other Emerging Threats (PIOET)
Influenza Pandêmica e Outras Ameaças Emergentes (PIOET)

description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

Apoia os seguintes custos ilustrativos financiados pelo programa: salários dos EUA, FSN e TCN e outros funcionários, como PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs que trabalham para o governo dos EUA, gerenciando, administrando e apoiando programas e seus benefícios financiados pelo programa, como habitação, viagens, transporte, subsídios de educação, etc.; contratantes institucionais que fornecem esse pessoal, aluguel, serviços de TI, a parcela de serviços públicos financiada pelo programa, custos de treinamento de pessoal e o custo de desenvolvimento e administração de programas de treinamento, equipamentos e suprimentos, ICASS, combustível e manutenção de veículos, contratos de manutenção, serviços de zeladoria, desenvolvimento e manutenção de páginas da unidade operacional na web, divulgação, como publicações e o custo de sua preparação (incluindo custos de pessoal), e assistência técnica para garantir a conformidade do USG com os regulamentos.

title.narrative: Pandemic Influenza and Other Emerging Threats (PIOET)
Influenza Pandêmica e Outras Ameaças Emergentes (PIOET)

description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

Apoia os seguintes custos ilustrativos financiados pelo programa: salários dos EUA, FSN e TCN e outros funcionários, como PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs que trabalham para o governo dos EUA, gerenciando, administrando e apoiando programas e seus benefícios financiados pelo programa, como habitação, viagens, transporte, subsídios de educação, etc.; contratantes institucionais que fornecem esse pessoal, aluguel, serviços de TI, a parcela de serviços públicos financiada pelo programa, custos de treinamento de pessoal e o custo de desenvolvimento e administração de programas de treinamento, equipamentos e suprimentos, ICASS, combustível e manutenção de veículos, contratos de manutenção, serviços de zeladoria, desenvolvimento e manutenção de páginas da unidade operacional na web, divulgação, como publicações e o custo de sua preparação (incluindo custos de pessoal), e assistência técnica para garantir a conformidade do USG com os regulamentos.

description.narrative: Supports the following illustrative program-funded costs: salaries of US, FSN, and TCN and other staff such as PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs working for the US Government managing, administering, and supporting programs and their program-funded benefits such as housing, travel, transportation, education allowances etc; institutional contractors that provide such staff, rent, IT services, the program-funded share of utilities, staff training costs and the cost of developing and administering training programs, equipment and supplies, ICASS, vehicle fuel and maintenance, maintenance contracts, janitorial services, operational unit web page development and maintenance, outreach such as publications and the cost of their preparation (including staff costs), and technical assistance to ensure USG compliance with regulations.

Apoia os seguintes custos ilustrativos financiados pelo programa: salários dos EUA, FSN e TCN e outros funcionários, como PSCs, RSSAs, PASAs, CASUs que trabalham para o governo dos EUA, gerenciando, administrando e apoiando programas e seus benefícios financiados pelo programa, como habitação, viagens, transporte, subsídios de educação, etc.; contratantes institucionais que fornecem esse pessoal, aluguel, serviços de TI, a parcela de serviços públicos financiada pelo programa, custos de treinamento de pessoal e o custo de desenvolvimento e administração de programas de treinamento, equipamentos e suprimentos, ICASS, combustível e manutenção de veículos, contratos de manutenção, serviços de zeladoria, desenvolvimento e manutenção de páginas da unidade operacional na web, divulgação, como publicações e o custo de sua preparação (incluindo custos de pessoal), e assistência técnica para garantir a conformidade do USG com os regulamentos.

title.narrative: HED Partnership: Strengthening Rural Agriculture Development

description.narrative: Ngozi University/South Carolina State University: Strengthening Rural Agriculture Development - The partnership has enhanced Ngozi University (NU) faculty pedagogical skills, revised the curriculum in agriculture and enhanced faculty research capacity. The partners established experimental research stations that increased NUs outreach capacity by providing extension services to local farmers and communities, producing and disseminating newly tested seeds for rice, fruits, and vegetables. These activities support improved nutrition, food security, and overall quality of life of the local farming communities. The partners are training trainers to enhance the skills of the extension agents who work with farmers, including a number of women farmers.

description.narrative: Improve the capacity of businesses to integrate into domestic and international markets through increases in productivity and improvements in corporate governance and the development and application of modern technology and marketing practices. Enhance the capacity of businesses and business associations in terms of their corporate governance capabilities and their application of best practices and technologies to achieve increased production and marketing of products and services. It includes adoption of efficient production processes, improved labor productivity, environmentally-sound management of natural resources and the development of accounting and management systems that can help the company and industry group implement business, labor, product and process standards that enhance business competitiveness. Business capacity development programs may include activities that help men- and women-owned firms and associations respond to these international markets and create regional alliances.

description.narrative: Increase the availability and use of proven life-saving interventions that address the major killers of mothers and children and improve their health and nutrition status, including effective maternity care and management of obstetric complications; prevention services including newborn care, routine immunization, polio eradication, safe water and hygiene, and micronutrients; improved maternal, infant and young child feeding; and treatment of life-threatening childhood illnesses.

Fournir des biens, du personnel, des services et une assistance pour répondre aux besoins humains fondamentaux afin de favoriser la transition après les secours selon les principes d'universalité, d'impartialité et de dignité humaine. Cet élément doit être réalisé, lorsque cela est possible, dans le cadre d'une approche intégrée, coordonnée et/ou multisectorielle.

Aumentar a disponibilidade e a utilização de intervenções comprovadamente salvadoras de vidas que abordem as principais causas de morte de mães e crianças e melhorem o seu estado de saúde e nutrição, incluindo cuidados de maternidade eficazes e gestão de complicações obstétricas; serviços de prevenção, incluindo cuidados neonatais, imunização de rotina, erradicação da poliomielite, água potável e higiene, e micronutrientes; melhoria da alimentação materna, infantil e infantil; e tratamento de doenças infantis potencialmente fatais.

description.narrative: Since 1988, the U.S. Census Bureau has worked with USAIDs Bureau for Global Health to enhance the quantity, quality, and utility of HIV/AIDS-related data. These data are used for policy development, program formulation, and monitoring and evaluation, and form anintegral part of USAIDs work in combating HIV/AIDS. Applying its extensive experience in epidemiological data base projections and population projection modeling, the Census Bureau has contributed to the USAID program with support in monitoring the spread of HIV and in understanding the effect the AIDS pandemic has on development.

Fournir des biens, du personnel, des services et une assistance pour répondre aux besoins humains fondamentaux afin de favoriser la transition après les secours selon les principes d'universalité, d'impartialité et de dignité humaine. Cet élément doit être réalisé, lorsque cela est possible, dans le cadre d'une approche intégrée, coordonnée et/ou multisectorielle.

Accroître la disponibilité et l'utilisation d'interventions vitales éprouvées qui s'attaquent aux principales causes de mortalité maternelle et infantile et améliorent leur état de santé et leur nutrition, y compris des soins de maternité efficaces et la gestion des complications obstétricales ; les services de prévention, notamment les soins néonatals, la vaccination systématique, l'éradication de la poliomyélite, l'eau potable et l'hygiène, ainsi que les micronutriments ; une meilleure alimentation de la mère, du nourrisson et du jeune enfant ; et le traitement des maladies infantiles potentiellement mortelles.

Depuis 1988, le Bureau du recensement des États-Unis travaille avec le Bureau de la santé mondiale de l'USAID pour améliorer la quantité, la qualité et l'utilité des données liées au VIH/SIDA. Ces données sont utilisées pour l'élaboration de politiques, la formulation de programmes, ainsi que le suivi et l'évaluation, et font partie intégrante du travail de l'USAID dans la lutte contre le VIH/SIDA. Fort de sa vaste expérience en matière de projections de bases de données épidémiologiques et de modélisation de projections démographiques, le Bureau du recensement a contribué au programme de l'USAID en soutenant la surveillance de la propagation du VIH et la compréhension de l'effet de la pandémie du SIDA sur le développement.

Depuis 1988, le Bureau du recensement des États-Unis travaille avec le Bureau de la santé mondiale de l'USAID pour améliorer la quantité, la qualité et l'utilité des données liées au VIH/SIDA. Ces données sont utilisées pour l'élaboration de politiques, la formulation de programmes, ainsi que le suivi et l'évaluation, et font partie intégrante du travail de l'USAID dans la lutte contre le VIH/SIDA. Fort de sa vaste expérience en matière de projections de bases de données épidémiologiques et de modélisation de projections démographiques, le Bureau du recensement a contribué au programme de l'USAID en soutenant la surveillance de la propagation du VIH et la compréhension de l'effet de la pandémie du SIDA sur le développement.

Desde 1988, o Gabinete do Censo dos EUA tem trabalhado com o Gabinete para a Saúde Global da USAID para melhorar a quantidade, a qualidade e a utilidade dos dados relacionados com o VIH/SIDA. Estes dados são utilizados para o desenvolvimento de políticas, formulação de programas, monitorização e avaliação, e constituem parte integrante do trabalho da USAID no combate ao VIH/SIDA. Aplicando a sua vasta experiência em projecções de bases de dados epidemiológicos e modelação de projecções populacionais, o Gabinete do Censo contribuiu para o programa da USAID com apoio na monitorização da propagação do VIH e na compreensão do efeito que a pandemia da SIDA tem no desenvolvimento.

title.narrative: Food and Nutrition Technical Assistance II (FANTA II)
Assistência Técnica Alimentar e Nutricional II (FANTA II)

description.narrative: The Food and Nutrition Technical Assistance Project (FANTA) has been working to improve the health and well-being of vulnerable individuals, families, and communities in developing countries by strengthening food security and nutrition policies, programs, and systems. The project provides comprehensive technical support to USAID and its partners, including host country governments, international organizations, and nongovernmental organizations. FANTA works at both the country and global levels, supporting the design and implementation of programs in focus countries, and building on field experience to strengthen the evidence base, methods, and global standards for food security and nutrition programming.

O Projecto de Assistência Técnica Alimentar e Nutricional (FANTA) tem trabalhado para melhorar a saúde e o bem-estar de indivíduos, famílias e comunidades vulneráveis ​​nos países em desenvolvimento, reforçando as políticas, programas e sistemas de segurança alimentar e nutricional. O projecto fornece apoio técnico abrangente à USAID e aos seus parceiros, incluindo governos dos países anfitriões, organizações internacionais e organizações não-governamentais. A FANTA trabalha tanto a nível nacional como global, apoiando a concepção e implementação de programas nos países em foco e aproveitando a experiência de campo para fortalecer a base de evidências, métodos e padrões globais para a programação de segurança alimentar e nutrição.

description.narrative: Strengthen the legal, regulatory, institutional, and information environment which protects and enables the growth in associational life and the development of independent and sustainable civil society organizations (CSOs). Build the capacity of civil society organizations to act as agents for reform and support their participation in democratic decision-making through articulating and representing their members interests, engaging in service delivery, and advocating for issues which become part of the public agenda and are reflected in public policies. Encourage the strengthening of a civic culture which supports democratic institutions and processes, active participation in political and civic life, and the civic virtues of tolerance, pluralism, compromise, trust, and respect for individual rights, including gender equality.

Fortalecer el entorno legal, regulatorio, institucional y de información que proteja y posibilite el crecimiento de la vida asociativa y el desarrollo de organizaciones de la sociedad civil (OSC) independientes y sostenibles. Desarrollar la capacidad de las organizaciones de la sociedad civil para actuar como agentes de reforma y apoyar su participación en la toma de decisiones democráticas mediante la articulación y representación de los intereses de sus miembros, la participación en la prestación de servicios y la promoción de cuestiones que pasan a formar parte de la agenda pública y se reflejan en las políticas públicas. Fomentar el fortalecimiento de una cultura cívica que apoye las instituciones y los procesos democráticos, la participación activa en la vida política y cívica y las virtudes cívicas de la tolerancia, el pluralismo, el compromiso, la confianza y el respeto por los derechos individuales, incluida la igualdad de género.

description.narrative: Increase the availability and use of proven life-saving interventions that address the major killers of mothers and children and improve their health and nutrition status, including effective maternity care and management of obstetric complications; prevention services including newborn care, routine immunization, polio eradication, safe water and hygiene, and micronutrients; improved maternal, infant and young child feeding; and treatment of life-threatening childhood illnesses.

Fournir aux enfants une éducation en lecture, en écriture et en mathématiques, ainsi que des compétences de base en résolution de problèmes, en apprentissage coopératif et en communication, afin de développer la capacité des élèves à obtenir et à utiliser les informations dont ils ont besoin sur leur foyer, leur communauté et leur pays. Les activités utilisent généralement un programme scolaire formel à l’intérieur ou à l’extérieur d’une école. L'enseignement primaire est aussi parfois appelé enseignement élémentaire.

description.narrative: Provide goods, personnel, services and assistance to meet basic human needs in order to foster transition from relief according to principles of universality, impartiality and human dignity. Aide au développement - Aide au développement

Proporcionar bienes, personal, servicios y asistencia para satisfacer las necesidades humanas básicas a fin de fomentar la transición del socorro de acuerdo con los principios de universalidad, imparcialidad y dignidad humana. Este elemento debería realizarse, cuando sea posible, como parte de un enfoque integrado, coordinado y/o multisectorial.
